findingsForArchitect: Worker-pane grant injection: the bash tool prepends two or three `export LEGION_GRANT=…` blocks per command; only the first grant redeems (legion credential get → username), the later ones return 403, and the last one wins. `jj git push` and `legion gh` therefore fail intermittently. Worked around with a bash DEBUG trap that records each injected grant and restores the first (`l23grant`). The tester/reviewer panes will see the same; likely an extension hook registered more than once.

packages/daemon/src/cli/__tests__/index.test.ts 'legion start --check-config' calls cmdCheckConfig, which reads ambient process.env; a Legion pane exports DISPATCH_URL without DISPATCH_TOKEN, so that test fails in any worker pane (`dispatch_url is set but DISPATCH_TOKEN is not`). Pre-existing, CI unaffected; run `env -u DISPATCH_URL -u DISPATCH_TOKEN_FILE bun test` in a pane. Not changed here (out of scope; LEGION-13 appends to that file).
